subject: Pearly (a8eabc) -> Iridescent: TWO DELTAS HANDED — repo-continuity older-entry condensation (char-HARD cure, conservation-checked, one stale-gate flag) + team-opener vocab-gen symlink line
body:
Iridescent — two handed deltas: (A) the routed repo-continuity char-HARD cure (condensed OLDER Current State entries, drafted per your grant; you land), and (B) the team-opener worktree-setup line for harvest item 9. Conservation check ran per entry: every dropped fact's permanent home is named inline; nothing is dropped whose only home was the condensed entry. One stale-fact FLAG for your adjudication, not silently rewritten: the output-schemas entry says execution "stays gated on the graph-tools-value-redesign mechanism settle" — that mechanism has since settled and executed (TRACK-G complete), so the plan may now be unblocked; my draft surfaces this as an open routing call rather than asserting it.

=== DELTA A: repo-continuity.md §Current State — four replacement entries ===

REPLACE the entry beginning "- **GRAPH-TOOLS READINESS → 🟢 DECISION-COMPLETE (2026-06-09, Fragrant Spreading Sapling..." (runs to "...graph-implementation-team.prompt.md`](../../prompts/connecting-oak-resources/graph-implementation-team.prompt.md).**") WITH:

- **GRAPH-TOOLS READINESS → 🟢 DECISION-COMPLETE (2026-06-09, Fragrant Spreading Sapling
  `47f78a`) — since EXECUTED in full (see the TRACK-G entry above).** The owner overturned the
  crude Step-0 split ("find the real membranes"); the seam analysis
  [`graph-tools-readiness-seam-analysis-2026-06-09.md`](../../reports/graph-tools-readiness-seam-analysis-2026-06-09.md)
  produced the owner-ratified deliverables map (S1/S2/S3, G1–G4, U1), the settled mechanisms
  (new `./graph-corpus` subpath; per-view `GraphView`, no substrate change; factory deleted at
  G3), and the pinned data facts; the plan's `get-keywords` bulk-corpus claim was FALSIFIED
  (live-API pass-through with narrowing params; owner disposition added U1 + G4). Detail and
  authority live in
  [`graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md`](../../plans/connecting-oak-resources/knowledge-graph-integration/current/graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md)
  (frontmatter todos + §Cycles and proof contract) and the merged readiness arc PRs #143–#148
  (incl. the indefinite-deferral trip-list, v1.18.0). Team shape (owner-ratified 2026-06-10):
  Director + Opus implementers in per-session worktrees; opener =
  [`graph-implementation-team.prompt.md`](../../prompts/connecting-oak-resources/graph-implementation-team.prompt.md).

(Dropped-fact homes: R1/R2 reviewer verdicts + conditions and the data-grounding specifics are pinned in the plan and the seam-analysis report; the plan mandates re-verifying pinned data facts at execution start, so the figures are not load-bearing here; bot-comment adjudication tallies live on the PR records; the "IMPLEMENTATION PHASE begins" next-step is superseded by TRACK-G completion — the top entry owns live next steps.)

REPLACE the entry beginning "- **A-i/C REVIEWS + GRAPH-TOOLS PROMOTION (2026-06-09, Brazen Roasting Cinder..." WITH:

- **A-i/C REVIEWS + GRAPH-TOOLS PROMOTION (2026-06-09, Brazen Roasting Cinder `527005`; PR
  #142 MERGED → v1.17.0).** The five deferred specialist reviews ran, every finding
  adjudicated first-hand (code/types/tests SOUND; verified findings landed);
  `graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md` PROMOTED future/→current/ (owner-decided). Skills §C
  licence framing (content is Oak's; preserve external-research attribution; `oak-brand` out,
  `oak-tone-of-voice` open) is carried in the plan's S3 deliverable.

(Dropped-fact homes: the three landed-finding SHAs live on PR #142's record; the MCP-surface-rationalisation capture lives in the plan.)

REPLACE the entry beginning "- **OUTPUT-SCHEMAS PLAN — 🟢 DECISION-COMPLETE (owner-ratified 2026-06-09).**..." WITH:

- **OUTPUT-SCHEMAS PLAN — 🟢 DECISION-COMPLETE (owner-ratified 2026-06-09).**
  [`output-schemas-for-mcp-tools.plan.md`](../../plans/sdk-and-mcp-enhancements/current/output-schemas-for-mcp-tools.plan.md):
  every MCP tool's `outputSchema` = `composeEnvelopeSchema(payloadSchema)`, payload Zod
  derived at the one source of truth per provenance; `composeEnvelopeSchema` lives in
  `oak-sdk-codegen`; the EEF tie is type-level, never `satisfies`-on-value. Its named
  execution gate — the graph-tools mechanism settle — has since SETTLED and executed
  (TRACK-G); execution routing is now an open Director/owner call. Cross-cutting: auto-memory
  `project_specialist_agent_design_overhaul` — verify every load-bearing specialist claim
  first-hand until the overhaul lands.

REPLACE the entry beginning "- **EEF build arc (D0–D7) DELIVERED + SHIPPED TO PRODUCTION (v1.16.0, 2026-06-08).**..." WITH:

- **EEF build arc (D0–D7) DELIVERED + SHIPPED (v1.16.0, 2026-06-08).** `get-eef-evidence` is
  live by default at `curriculum-mcp-alpha.oaknational.dev` (kill-switch flag, default ON;
  ADR-193 boundary holds). Potential teacher value proven by release-and-observe (owner
  2026-06-08); delivered-value stays with
  [`eef-outcome-evaluation-infrastructure.plan.md`](../../plans/sector-engagement/eef/future/eef-outcome-evaluation-infrastructure.plan.md).
  Full arc: the [`eef` record][eef].

LEAVE UNCHANGED: the TRACK-G top entry (yours, live churn — though note its "Live lanes NOW" facts pre-date today's three closeouts), the EXTERNAL-FACING entry (compact; carries open owner decisions #4/#5), the product-focus and collaboration-state-lifecycle standing notes, and everything outside §Current State.

Estimated relief: ~2.5–3k chars (36.4k → comfortably under the 35k hard limit) with zero substance loss.

=== DELTA B: team opener §Worktree setup — one added line ===

Append to the guidance in graph-implementation-team.prompt.md §"Worktree setup":

If a deliverable runs vocab-gen: `apps/oak-search-cli/bulk-downloads` is gitignored and
machine-local — symlink the data files from the primary checkout into the worktree's
skeleton dir (git-invisible; proven in the PR-180 cycle). Know the generator-task mapping
before assuming a regen ran: `data.json` is written by vocab-gen, and a FULL-TURBO replay
on sdk-codegen can mask that vocab-gen never re-emitted.

(Register entry "Worktree vocab-gen needs the gitignored bulk-downloads" tracks this as handed; flips to graduated when your edit lands.)
